reporting.finding: A guest serial trace record was interrupted by native POOL_DISCARD_JSON output in the shared stdout log. A clean ftrace ring does not establish intact export.
reporting.corrective_action: Separate the VMM logger via --log-path vmm.log, guest serial stdout via fc.log, and stderr via stderr.log on each boot/restore. stdout/stderr redirection alone is insufficient because the default logger writes stdout.

baseline.interpretation: The diagnostic had no matched do_wp_page calls and was correctly rejected. This does not establish that no CoW occurred.
baseline.source_hypothesis_not_runtime_proven: The caller re-admits/remaps canonical pages but does not read them after admission and before profiling. First-write faults can take do_cow_fault and the custom DAX vmf->cow_page copy path instead of do_wp_page. Root is validating the profiler separately.

preservation: Original suite and arm statuses and bytes were not rewritten. Both stopped outer runs, receipts and measured sources are archived. No timing from either arm enters formal performance.
